title: Voi cânta bunătatea Ta (Revive)
notes: Right hand: fingerstyle, no pick. Thumb (p) takes the bass string, index (i) lives on the G string, middle (m) on the B string, ring (a) on the high e. Play over the neck pickup with a dotted-eighth delay and reverb.

Verses: the 3-3-3-3-2-2 pattern. Count the 16ths 1 e & a 2 e & a 3 e & a 4 e & a; plucks fall on 1, a-of-1, &-of-2, e-of-3, 4, &-of-4. The delay fills the gaps, so keep the pattern steady and let every string ring.

Form: Intro - Verse 1 (16 bars) - Chorus 1 (quiet) - Verse 2 - Chorus 2 x2 - Tag - Bridge - Breakdown (guitar out) - Final chorus. The bass walks (F/C, Bb/D, C/E); the guitar stays on the shapes shown.
notes_movable: Same part with no open strings: F as x-8-10-10-8-8 (keeps the add9 colour), Dm7 x-5-7-5-6-5, Dsus4 x-5-7-7-8-5, Bbmaj7 as the E-shape at 6, Bb and C as E-shape barres. Keep the hand between frets 5 and 10.

pick.desc: Verses and intro: 3-3-3-3-2-2 fingerpicking, one bar = 16 sixteenths. 1: thumb bass + middle on B. a-of-1: index on G. &-of-2: fingers brush D G B e. e-of-3: index on G. 4: thumb bass + middle on B. &-of-4: index G + middle B. Let everything ring.

strum.desc: Choruses: fingerstyle strums, thumb down (D), fingers up (U). Count 1 . & 3 & 4 &  ->  D . D D U D U, with a light thumb tap on 2. Accent 1 and the & of 2.

pulse.desc: Tag and bridge: thumb plucks the bass on 1, then middle + ring pinch the top two strings on every eighth note (1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &). Steady and even; this is the build under the bridge vocal.

sections.name: Intro (0:03)
sections.note: Guitar alone with keys, two bars of F. Start the pattern straight away.

sections.name: Verse 1 (0:08)
sections.note: Drums enter halfway. Bar 2 of each phrase: F for two beats, then Am on beats 3-4 walks the bass down into Dm. Bar 6: Bbmaj7 then C/E on beats 3-4 walks up into F.

sections.name: Chorus 1 (0:50) - quiet
sections.note: Band drops out; strum softly with the thumb and let it swell. The bass plays E under the C in bar 2 on the record.

sections.name: Verse 2 (1:12)
sections.note: Full band, same picking.

sections.name: Tag (2:37)
sections.note: Vocals and drums. Switch to the eighth-note pulse on the top two strings.

sections.name: Bridge (2:48)
sections.note: Half-bar changes in bars 4, 6, 7, 8, 10. Keep the pulse going through every change; the bass does the walking.

sections.name: Breakdown (3:20) - guitar tacet
sections.note: Vocals + pad only; chords given for reference. Come back in on the final chorus.

sections.name: Final chorus (3:36)
sections.note: Ends on C, let it ring.

title: Să-nalț jertfa Ta, Isuse - BBSO (live arrangement)
key: D minor (0:00-2:30), then E major (2:31-3:50), then F minor (3:51-end)
notes: This recording is a three-part arrangement that modulates twice: the main song in D minor (Dm Gm A F C Bb), a middle part in E major (F#m B E G#m C#m A), and a final part in F minor (Fm Ab Eb/G C Db Bb). Each part is charted in its own key below.

The electric guitar is low in the mix for most of this recording: it swells in the intro (A to Dm), plays a quiet broken-chord figure under the second verse/chorus of part A, is nearly inaudible in part B (pads only), and plays broken chords again in part C. Where the stem is silent the chords are given for reference and the bar is marked tacet.
Chord detection is less certain in the quiet, piano-only passages (verse 1, part B first half); treat those bars as a guide.
notes_movable: Transposition table below is for part A (root D). For part B the shapes are rooted on E (E at 7 A-shape, B at 7 E-shape, F#m at 2, C#m at 4, G#m at 4), for part C on F (Fm at 8 A-shape, C at 8, Ab at 4, Db at 4, Eb at 6).

arp.desc: Part A: slow broken chord  p . . . i m . . a . . . m . . .   (bass on 1, two notes on 2, top on 3, inner on 4), let ring.

arp2.desc: Part A chorus / part C: syncopated broken chord  p . . i . . m . . a . . i . a .

hold.desc: Swells: one strum per bar (or per half bar when the chord changes), volume-swell in, let ring.

sections.name: Transition to part B (2:13)
sections.note: Modulation passage; chords approximate.

sections.name: PART B - chorus (3:07)

title: The Lord's Prayer (It's Yours) - Matt Maher
tempo: 76 bpm (half-time feel; the beat tracker reads 152)
audio: audio/The Lord's Prayer (It's Yours) Matt Maher.mp3
audio_noguitar: audio/noguitar/The Lord's Prayer (It's Yours) Matt Maher.mp3
notes: The electric guitar lives on an open-A pedal for most of the song: the low A string keeps pulsing in 8ths while the upper voicing moves A -> E/A -> D/A -> Asus2. The verses are effectively 'A with colour', not real chord changes; chorus and bridge have the actual changes (D A | E | ... A/C# D E F#m).
Form: Intro - Verse 1 - Chorus 1 - Verse 2 - Chorus 2 - Verse 3 (quiet) - Bridge - Final chorus/tag.
Intro motif: a two-bar ambient line over the A pedal (approximate, it is drenched in delay): A3 - A4 - G4 - D4 - C4 - A3.
notes_movable: Without open strings the A pedal becomes the low E string at the 5th fret; shapes: E-shape A at 5, D/A as a 5th-fret barre, E at 7 (A-shape), D at 5 (A-shape), F#m at 2, Bm at 7.

pedal.desc: Verses/intro: bass (A) pedal in pulsing 8ths with a slap-back repeat on the 'e'; add the top three strings on the '&' of 2 and of 4.

strum8.desc: Chorus/bridge: straight 8th-note strum  D D D U D U D U  (accent beats 1 and 3, lighter on the ups).

soft.desc: Quiet verse: one bass note on 1, top strings on the '&' of 2, let ring.

sections.name: Intro (0:01)
sections.note: Guitar + pad, twelve bars. First two bars show the motif (tab numbers are the actual notes), then the pedal pattern.

sections.name: Verse 1 (0:38)
sections.note: Drums enter. Keep the open A ringing; only the upper voicing changes.

sections.name: Chorus 1 (1:04)
sections.note: Half-bar changes D A in bars 1, 3, 5 and A F#m in bar 6.

sections.name: Verse 2 (1:30)
sections.note: Back on the pedal.

sections.name: Verse 3 (2:24) - quiet
sections.note: Drums out, vocals and guitar only.

sections.name: Bridge (2:43)
sections.note: The one place the bass line really moves: A - A/C# - D - E - F#m - E.

sections.name: Final chorus / tag (3:12)
sections.note: Band on A for the 'It's yours' tag; end on A, let ring.

title: Christus Victor (Amen) - Keith & Kristyn Getty, Cochren & Co.
notes: Electric guitar: broken-chord 8ths in the verses (low F3/C4 register, mostly the four lowest strings of each shape), driving 16th-syncopated strums in the choruses, sparse held chords in the interludes. The bridge ('Amen, amen...') walks F - C - Dm - Am - Gm - C - Dm - C/E in half bars.
The chord the bass plays under the second bar of the verse loop reads as C with D and F on top (Csus2/4); it is written here as Csus4 - the plain C shape works too.
Form: Intro - Verse 1 - Chorus 1 - Interlude - Verse 2 - Chorus 2 - Interlude 2 - Verse 3 - Chorus 3 - Bridge - Final chorus - Outro.
notes_movable: F = A-shape barre at 8, C = E-shape at 8 (Csus4 adds the 10th fret on the G string), Gm = E-shape at 3, Bb = E-shape at 6, Dm = Am-shape at 5. Slash chords use 4-string voicings so the bass note is right: C/E x-7-10-9-8-x, Bb/D x-5-8-7-6-x, Dm/A x-x-7-7-6-5, F/A x-x-7-5-6-5.

arp.desc: Verses: 8th-note broken chord  p i m a i m a p a  (bass on 1, climb, re-strike bass on 4). Accents fall on 2 and 3.

strum16.desc: Choruses: 16th-note push pattern  1 . . a 2 . . a 3 e . a 4 . & .   ->   D . . U D . . U D . U D . U .

hold.desc: Interludes/outro: strum on 1, let ring, pick the top three strings on the 'a' of 3, strum on 4.

arp8.desc: Bridge: steady 8th-note arpeggio p m a m, chord changes on beat 3.

sections.name: Intro (0:01)
sections.note: Piano leads; the guitar doubles quietly.

sections.name: Verse 1 (0:13)
sections.note: Electric is barely audible until the last two bars; chords for reference, play the pattern softly.

sections.name: Chorus 1 (0:44)
sections.note: Drums in. Half-bar changes in bars 4 and 6.

sections.name: Chorus 2 (1:47)
sections.note: Double chorus.

sections.name: Interlude 2 (2:27)
sections.note: Drops to vocals + guitar for the last four bars.

sections.name: Bridge (3:45)
sections.note: Four-bar loop played three times; third time the Am becomes A (major) pulling to Dm.

sections.name: Final chorus (4:23)
sections.note: Extended chorus with a Dm/Bb/C tail.

sections.name: Outro (5:16)
sections.note: Ends on F, let ring.

title: Vino cu noi - HYChoir
key: F major (chords F, C, Gm, Dm, Am, Bb; strong C-mixolydian colour, the key profile alone reads C)
notes: The electric guitar is silent for the first 1:50 (piano, choir). It enters at 1:51 with a dotted-8th delay riff on three notes (E4 F4 C5 over F, then over C), then plays chord strums for the choruses and bridge, building to driving strums in the final chorus.
Riff: play B-string 5 (E), B-string 6 (F), e-string 8 (C) as a 16th-note cycle; with a dotted-8th delay you only need to pick the first note of every three and the delay fills the rest.
Form: Intro - Verse 1 (no guitar) - Riff - Chorus 1 - Turnaround - Chorus 2 - Bridge - Quiet - Final chorus - Outro.
notes_movable: F = A-shape barre at 8, C = E-shape at 8, Gm = E-shape at 3, Dm = Am-shape at 5, Am = Em-shape at 5, Bb = E-shape at 6, C/E x-7-10-9-8-x, F/A x-x-7-5-6-5. The riff is already at frets 5-8 and transposes with everything else.

sparse.desc: Chorus 1: strum on 1 and the '&' of 1, let ring, strum again on 4 with an up on the 'a' of 4.

strumA.desc: Chorus 2 / bridge: D . D . | . . . . | D . . . | D . . U   (beats 1, 1&, 3, 4, push on 'a' of 4).

drive.desc: Final chorus: D . . U D . . . D . U . D U . .   (16th pushes on 'a' of 1, '&' of 3 and 'e' of 4).

hold.desc: Quiet section / outro: one strum per half bar, let ring.

sections.name: Intro (0:01) - piano only
sections.note: Guitar tacet. Chords for reference.

sections.name: Verse 1 (0:30) - piano + choir, guitar tacet
sections.note: Chords for reference only (the guitar does not play here).

sections.name: Guitar riff (1:51)
sections.note: Electric enters. 16th-note cycle E-F-C with dotted-8th delay; chords F F F/C C underneath.

sections.name: Chorus 1 (2:03)
sections.note: Drums enter. Keep the delay on; chords ring between strums.

sections.name: Chorus 2 (3:01)
sections.note: Half-bar changes in bars 1, 5 and 6.

sections.name: Bridge (3:27)
sections.note: Builds; mostly half-bar changes.

sections.name: Quiet (3:53)
sections.note: Drums out, choir + guitar.

sections.name: Final chorus (4:16)
sections.note: Full band. The first two bars and bars 11-13 change every two beats, the rest one chord per bar.

sections.name: Outro (5:20)
